entities.summary: James Stephen Ringo was an American professional football player and coach in the National Football League (NFL). He played 15 years as a center for the Green Bay Packers and the Philadelphia Eagles, earning 10 Pro Bowl selections. At one time he held the record for most consecutive games played (182). He was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 1981.
